mapper.select: SELECT fin.finprod_id finProdId, finAdd.IS_LAY isLay, pafin.DEAL_MODE dealType, (CASE WHEN ale.FIRST_SALE_VDATE=null THEN '' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(fin.VDATE,'%Y%m%d') END) vdate FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finAdd ON fin.FINPROD_ID = finAdd.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT pafin ON fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID AND finAdd.Sale_Department = #{saleDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN PRD_SALE_PARAM sale ON sale.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID AND DATE_FORMAT(sale.FIRST_SALE_VDATE, '%Y%m%d') = #{startdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DATE_FORMAT(sale.FIRST_SALE_MDATE, '%Y%m%d') = #{enddate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select (CASE WHEN padeal.PA_BUSS_TYPE ='01' THEN padeal.THEORY_RATE ELSE padeal.ACT_RATE END) yield, padeal.BASIS interestMode, deal.FINPROD_ID finProdId, deal.Trade_Amt amt from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal left join PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL padeal on padeal.Trade_Id = deal.Trade_Id where deal.totle_trade_id = #{totleTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and deal.ps = #{tradePS,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
